additional_context: Medication remains active in source/fhir.ini, and the old Medication.form path maps to current Medication.doseForm. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-19296 intentionally changed the medication form parent from 421967003 to 736542009; duplicate FHIR-22272 and Zulip discussion explain that 421967003 was ambiguous/retired, and FHIR-24700/FHIR-25441 treated subsequent 736542009 expansion errors as tooling/cache issues rather than source-definition errors.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reverting to 421967003 would undo a later accepted Pharmacy correction, and the route-of-administration parent reported in FHIR-7265 is no longer present in the active Medication value set source.
